chapters.label: Live: Bangkok 2012
chapters.text: The 2012 Futsal World Cup, in Bangkok. Captain Sergei Sergeev scores after thirty four seconds! He gets three, and Russia beat Guatemala nine nil. In the whole group, they let in none.

chapters.label: How he covers
chapters.text: Sergeev was calm at the back. This is how he covers: a teammate goes to the ball. Sergeev waits behind, to the side. The attacker gets past, but Sergeev is already there, and takes the ball!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again. Behind, to the side, ready!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: cover your teammate’s back, so nobody gets a free run at goal!
